provenance.mark_note: mark-price klines are used where the mark archive has a bar; the perp 1h high/low stand in before a symbol's first mark bar and for holes after it (counts per symbol in ranges[*].perp_fallback_mark_bars). First mark bar end per symbol: ranges[*].first_mark_bar_end (earliest 2020-12-01 01:00:00+00:00, latest 2024-04-02 09:00:00+00:00; 0 symbols without any mark bar)

effective_window.note: stamp d covers day d-1; leading stamps before the first non-zero account return are trimmed

result.max_safe_leverage_rule: largest L with P(ruin 365d) <= 5% in EVERY reported sample and no liquidations in the 2023-2026 path (conservative reading of the registration)
